features.blogDesc: Write SEO-friendly blog posts to attract more customers.

overview.needHelpDesc: If you can't find the answer, contact our support team via WhatsApp or email

tab.escToClose: ESC to close · Pinch to zoom on mobile

steps.title: Access Products Menu
steps.desc: From the left Sidebar, click on "📦 Products" to open your current product list.

steps.title: Create New Product
steps.desc:
Click the [+ Add Product] button at the top right. Fill out the form:
  • Product name, RM price, detailed description
  • Upload product images (WebP recommended, ≤ 5MB/image)
  • Enable Halal Badge if the product has JAKIM certification
  • Set inventory and shipping weight

steps.title: Manage Product Images
steps.desc: Drag and drop or click Browse Files to upload multiple images. Drag and drop to reorder. The first image will be the primary image on the Storefront.

steps.title: View Order List
steps.desc: Go to "🛒 Orders" to view all orders. Use the Status filter to find orders that need processing.

steps.title: Process Orders
steps.desc: Click on an order to view details. Update status: Confirmed → Shipped → Delivered. Enter J&T/Pos Laju tracking code.

steps.title: Dashboard Overview
steps.desc: The dashboard displays key metrics: total revenue, number of orders, visitors, and Quick Actions.

steps.title: Create New Blog Post
steps.desc: Go to "📝 Blog" → click [+ New Post]. Write content using the Rich Text Editor, add images, and set SEO meta.

steps.title: Domain Configuration
steps.desc: Go to "⚙️ Settings → Domains". Add custom domain, configure DNS (A Record, CNAME), and verify connection.

qna.emptyDesc: Try different keywords or contact support via WhatsApp.

categories.aAddProduct: Go to Products menu → click [+ Add Product] at top right. Fill in name, RM price, description, upload product images (max 10, WebP recommended). Click Save.
categories.aMultipleImages: Drag and drop images into upload area, or use Browse Files. Max 10 images, ≤ 5MB each. Formats: JPG, PNG, WebP.
categories.aHalal: Halal Badge (JAKIM) shows on Product Card and Product Detail Page at storefront. Enable it in product form → Halal Certification section.
categories.aCod: COD orders will have a Pending Payment status until shipper confirms collection. You can manually update status in order details → Mark as Paid.
categories.aInvoice: Go to Orders → select order → click Print Invoice or Print Packing Slip. The system will generate a PDF for printing.
categories.aFpx: EchPrime supports: FPX (Malaysia online banking), Credit/Debit Card (Visa, Mastercard), DuitNow QR, COD (Cash on Delivery), and manual Bank Transfer.
categories.aSst: Yes, when you enable SST in Store Settings → Tax Configuration, the system calculates 6% SST automatically and displays it clearly to the buyer.
